about: Answer key written by hand from tasks/invoices/seed.json, data/additions.json and tasks/invoices/domain.md. It is not produced by the application. scripts/check_expected.py re-checks the arithmetic and the ID links without importing the app.

documents.rule: Rule 2: S1 + PO-1 match. Rule 3: expected = ordered quantity x agreed unit price.
documents.arithmetic: expected 5 x 2000 = 10000; billed 10000; 10000 - 10000 = 0; billed qty 5 = ordered 5 = received 5 (RC-1)

documents.rule: Rule 4: billed - expected, positive = overcharge (the worked example in domain.md).
Rule 4: same supplier ID + invoice number (S1, INV-1) as the document 'clean', which was received first.
documents.arithmetic: none: a duplicate is not payable and not recoverable

documents.rule: Rule 2: no purchase-order reference. PO-1 and PO-2 both look the same by amount, so nothing is matched.
documents.arithmetic: none: no expected amount without a match

documents.rule: Rule 3: billed quantity is compared with received quantity. Billed 5, received 4 (README assumption 2: a quantity difference is discrepant even when the amount difference is 0).
documents.arithmetic: expected 5 x 3500 = 17500; billed 17500; 17500 - 17500 = 0; billed qty 5 vs received 4 (RC-3)

documents.rule: Rule 2: conflicting reference. The invoice is from S2 but PO-1 belongs to S1.
documents.arithmetic: none: no expected amount without a match

documents.rule: Rule 2: the invoice prints P0-4 (digit zero). There is no such purchase order, and the closest-looking one (PO-4) must not be picked automatically.
documents.arithmetic: none: no expected amount without a match

documents.rule: Simulated model/API failure (labelled simulated-failure). The batch must continue.
Blurred image: no field can be read, so nothing may be extracted or matched.

summary.arithmetic: recoverable = positive differences on discrepant invoices = 2000 (wrong-price) + 0 (short-receipt); payable = clean, wrong-price, short-receipt

document.rule: After a reviewer corrects the reference to PO-4: S1 + PO-4 match; billed unit price 13.00 vs agreed 12.50.
document.arithmetic: expected 10 x 1250 = 12500; billed 10 x 1300 = 13000; 13000 - 12500 = 500; billed qty 10 = ordered 10 = received 10 (RC-4)
